I was the one who loved you then, now, and in the future. I just couldn’t let you go.’
Layla, daughter of a brothel prostitute.
To escape her miserable brothel life, she stole the identity of a noble lady.

“It’s been a while, Layla. My maid.”
It was a name he hadn’t heard in nearly a decade. He had tried to forget it, tried to make it go away.

Leopold Lear Edehardt, Count of Rhineland, illegitimate son of King Franz II, and Layla’s first love. It was a name she had never forgotten.

One day, while living as a money-grubbing, unscrupulous lawyer, I found myself transmigrated as Elena Christie, a penniless extra in a fantasy romance novel.
“Let’s see, who has the biggest bounty on their head?”
To escape a poverty hell more terrifying than the inferno itself, I decided to defend Benedict Richard, the story’s ultimate villain, a duke on the verge of execution for mu*der. My reward for success? Half of his confiscated fortune.
“Is there any evidence here, in this courtroom, that the defendant committed this mu*der?”
I thought I’d torn the courtroom apart with my flawless arguments…. What?  They’ll only return his assets if I catch the real culprit? Fine. I’ll catch the real culprit. I’ll get the money.  And so, I ran myself ragged chasing the true mu*derer, even going so far as to fix the Duke’s finances, which were on the brink of collapse after his assets were seized. I even managed his public image, tarnished by the mu*derer label, thinking it might help secure his acquittal. I was utterly swamped, all to protect my future payday.
“We have a contract, nothing more. Don’t expect anything else.”
The Duke delivered the unnecessary, and rather dramatic, pronouncement that there would be no special incentives beyond the agreed-upon fee. I shook my head at his surprising stinginess, so unlike his imposing figure.
* * *
“Ha….”
Benedict Richard sighed, a sound heavy with anguish. This was a serious predicament.  He pressed a hand to his forehead, his face etched with worry, and muttered, “I think Elena Christie likes me.”
Something decidedly unusual was happening. He was certain of it.

95534.synopsis:
Song Yingshi transmigrated into a cliche drama novel where three male protagonists tried to force their love upon Huai Xu, the female protagonist,

Use your “knowledge of otome games” to live as a commoner in hiding?
…Pathetic.
Find a lover better than your fiancé and have them take revenge?

Friendship and love are unnecessary. If it’s for revenge, I’ll bow my head, but I will always crush them all later, without fail.

Then, she was framed for another crime she didn’t commit and was executed. She died cursing everything in this world that had wronged her, but when she woke up, she was ten years old again, revived.

99374.synopsis:
Lin Zhi was on his way to meet his boyfriend when he bravely intervened in an incident, tragically sacrificing his life.
Returning to three years ago, Lin Zhi decided to seize the opportunity to make up for the regrets of his previous life while striving to become a better version of himself in order to win over his boyfriend.
What Lin Zhi didn’t expect was that the class monitor, Lu Liu, whom he couldn’t have in his past life, began to grow closer and closer to him…
In Lu Liu’s eyes:
I’ve liked Lin Zhi for a long time. He’s kind, well-liked, and has many friends.
But he seems to dislike me, always keeping his distance whenever we meet.
I also heard that he has a boyfriend…
Never mind, I can’t be the third wheel.
In Lin Zhi’s eyes:
Lu Liu was my crush in my past life. He’s smart and gentle with everyone.
But he seems to dislike me, always cold whenever he talks to me.
And I still need to go find my boyfriend from the past life…
Forget it, I can’t “ride two boats.”
In the eyes of passersby:
Who exactly likes whom? Who hates whom?
And by the way, who’s the one being cheated on?
Lu Liu: Well… it seems I’ve cheated on myself!
【Little Drama】
In an unexpected incident, Lin Zhi fell right into Lu Liu’s arms. As he hastily stood up, he noticed that Lu Liu’s ears were red as if they were bleeding.
While adjusting his clothes, Lin Zhi thought: I didn’t blush, so why are you blushing?

100142.synopsis:
In a romance fantasy world, I was born into a moderately wealthy family.
Living the life of a true couch potato, I spent my days eating, lounging, and lazing around to my heart’s content.
But one day…
“I heard you were a frail and demure young lady. Seems like I’ve got the wrong person—way off the mark.”
At an imperial ball I was forced to attend, my carefully hidden “indoor-only” personality was completely exposed.
And to none other than Armin Grey, the duke’s heir, who is as arrogant as he is handsome!
“You’ll keep this a secret… right?”
“Why should I? I’ve never encountered someone this entertaining in my entire life.”
From Armin Grey, who begins to sneak his way into my life,
To the duke and duchess, who keep trying to tie me to their son:
“Who else but us could welcome Lady Vivian as a daughter-in-law?”
“I’ve always wanted a cute, like-minded daughter.”
As I get entangled with the duke’s family, cracks begin to form in my once peaceful life as a wallflower, hidden away in the social scene!

102702.synopsis:
Gu Wanrong, a recently graduated unemployed youth, accidentally swapped bodies with her counterpart from a parallel world four years ago during a job interview. She then discovered she had bound a system that gives rebates for every purchase she makes.
From then on, Gu Wanrong happily lived a life of spending and receiving rebates.
Luxury goods, buy! System rebating!
Mansions, buy! System rebating!
Luxury cars, buy! System rebating!
Day by day, Gu Wanrong achieved financial freedom and became a billionaire.
Huh? The system not only gives rebates but also enhances beauty. Body, skin, appearance attributes +1 +1 +1…
Day by day, Gu Wanrong underwent a beautiful transformation, becoming a stunning beauty.
Online Worker Complaint Post:
Boss is stingy, demanding, unintelligent, balding… low pay, habitual overtime, single day off…
Gu Wanrong’s company employees: We have high salaries! 10 am to 4 pm work hours! Double or triple days off! Company housing provided! And the boss is a rich and generous stunning beauty!
Other workers: Fake, it’s all fake! (Privately, they rush to submit their resumes after finding out which company it is!)

105006.synopsis:
I saved the villains who would one day bring ruin to the empire. I raised them with love so they wouldn’t stray down the wrong path.  
And yet, I became the evil god feared by the entire continent.  
Why on earth?

105518.synopsis:
Lyla, disguised as her deceased brother Lyle, lives under his identity.
The guilt of deceiving everyone and the self-loathing from knowing she is a fraud slowly eat away at her.
One drunken night, she ends up sharing a bed with her lord, Kadis…
“Lord Kadis, why are we in the same bed?”
“We made a mistake.”
“How could two men… do such a thing?”
“It’s possible.”
Kadis, calmly recounting the events of the previous night, and Lyla, in complete denial of reality.
“What if strange rumors spread? Lord Kadis, you need to continue your lineage!”
“Then you can bear my child.”
“W-What nonsense are you spouting? I’m a man! How could a man have a child?”
“Oh, is that so? For someone claiming that, it went in just fine. Smoothly, actually.”
As Lyla continues to deny it, Kadis raises his right arm and begins punching the air.
“At this rate, you might even be able to have kids.”
When his raised arm slowly lowered, Lyla instinctively tensed her lower body.
That massive forearm felt as though it was slipping out from beneath her.
Could she really have shared a bed with her lord last night?
In the end,
Lyla, reaching her breaking point, decides to leave Kadis behind.
“Should Lyle leave the territory, kill any pests that cling to him. Leave no one alive.”
But just as Lyla is about to face another crisis…
“Be grateful, Lyle. Today, I’ll make you a woman.”
It wasn’t just Lyla who had reached her limit.
Kadis, too, finally unleashed the long-held feelings of affection and the beast-like desire that came with them.
“You want my body, don’t you? Fine. I’ll give it to you. So please, stop destroying yourself because of someone like me…”
Lyla looked up at Kadis with the utmost submissiveness.
But Kadis wasn’t fooled.
It was obvious she thought he wouldn’t remember anything the next day because of how drunk he was.
Kadis smirked and grabbed Lyla’s chin, tilting it upward.
“You’re not giving anything.”
“W-What?”
“I’m the one giving it to you.”
Kadis leaned close to Lyla’s ear and whispered, making sure she understood.
“My v*rginity. I’m giving it to you.”
This time, it was real.
A genuine crisis for her c*astity.

106542.synopsis:
His arrogance and insolence knew no bounds, sparing no one. A man beautiful yet untouchable, whom she yearned to define but dared not depict. She couldn’t deny the longing and attraction for something she had never possessed. But Cha-eon vaguely sensed it. This man was a poisoned chalice. A dangerous man who threatened to destroy everything if she dared to drink.
For a while, she silently stared at their touching fingertips. What was he thinking? Cha-eon let out a dry laugh and smiled a little. When she raised her head, she met his eyes, still tilted down, watching her. The man’s eyes, perfectly suited to the dawn, were fixed on her.
“I told you to keep your eyes to yourself. You’ll be misunderstood. Can’t you control yourself?”
Suddenly, she wondered. Did this man treat other women like this too? Even women who desired him? Tap, tap. The subtle rhythm of raindrops drumming against the window, the sound of rain growing faster like breaths. Just as the sweltering heat seemed to subside, the rain returned. The monsoon, which seemed to be ending, had started again.

108078.synopsis:
Chao Jinsu possessed unparalleled beauty and an innate sword-bearing bone. She could defeat ten thousand foes with one sword. She was a genius admired by countless people and was even destined to become the future sect leader.
Yet, in the year she underwent her Nascent Soul Tribulation, she was afflicted with a Love Gu. In a dazed state, she dreamt of her own future. She saw that she was nothing more than the “white moonlight” sacrificed to the heavens in a storybook.
The first half of her life was smooth sailing. She was cherished by her sect and worshipped by many.
But after being poisoned by the Love Gu and forcibly expelled at the cost of severe injuries became the turning point of her fate –
For the sake of the righteous path, she fought a life-and-death battle against the world-destroying demon. Yet in the end, she was shot through the heart by an arrow by the very sect she had trusted.
After her death, she was branded a ‘traitor’ overnight, spat on by millions, and even her soul was shattered into nothingness by her junior disciple; the male protagonist.
After the junior disciple seized control of the sect, he even found a so-called “substitute”, and under the guise of mourning his “white moonlight,” he did all kinds of filthy acts.
When she woke up, she had returned to the moment she was poisoned by the Love Gu.
This time, she was no longer willing to be a martyr.
Looking at the world-destroying demon across from her, who had just fought her for three days and three nights, she wiped the blood from the corner of her mouth and thought:
There was no other choice. No one else was within a hundred miles. This idiot would have to do.
A spring night is fleeting, and the sun rises late. The cold and otherworldly sword cultivator fastened her robe, gifted him her sword, and coolly stated: “Once every three months. I’ll come find you.”
The ruler of the demon realm, feared by all was furious. But who would have thought that after taking a few steps away, the sword cultivator would turn back, effortlessly pull him close by the collar, kiss him, and say indifferently: “Keep your mouth shut.”
The furious demon lord: o(*////▽////*)q

109102.synopsis:
As a transmigrator, Zhou Heng possessed a heaven-defying talent and an unparalleled background—he was undoubtedly one of the most elite disciples!
However, what he didn’t expect was… the system actually chose the wrong host!
As the Holy Son, should he go kill a weakling at the Qi Refining Realm? Just saying it out loud would bring shame to his sect!
As the Holy Son, should he go crush some insignificant power in the mortal world? That would be like using a butcher’s knife to kill a chicken!
As the Holy Son, should he go hug a beautiful fairy from a small sect? Zhou Heng said—this one, he’s fine with!

111662.synopsis:
Forensic expert Lin Chu was suddenly thrown into an infinite apocalypse.
When others see zombies: “Oh my god, disgusting creatures covered in blood and flesh, stay away!”
When Lin Chu sees zombies: “Moving 206 bones! Walking points, the more, the better!”
Relying on her old profession, she quickly adapted to the bloody apocalyptic world.
In a place full of chaos, others avoid it, but Lin Chu’s eyes gleam as she charges forward.
In her left hand, a thigh bone; in her right, expired medicine—both are good items, after all, she has the ability to turn waste into treasure.
Zombies, storms, earthquakes, fire rains, acid rains, locust plagues… one apocalyptic dimension after another attacks.
Fortunately, even though she’s in an apocalyptic world, the system kindly arranged a safehouse for her.
She only needs to find an intact door and settle it within the specified time.
While others scramble and fight, Lin Chu calmly pulls out a door from her space that she had picked up in the last dimension while scavenging…

115758.synopsis:
“I am willing to offer my soul to you, in exchange for the power to pursue justice.”
Before the throne of the Lord of Hell, Evelia once said this to Satan.

associated_names: 正义恶魔小姐不会遇上白切黑天使

116526.synopsis:
Su Qiqian died suddenly from overwork and transmigrated into the body of an S-Class Guide with the same name in a dark-themed sentinel world.
She imagined a high-quality life surrounded by admirers, but when she opened her eyes, she found herself convicted of an unforgivable crime and sentenced to exile in the Black Tower!
In this world, all sentinels are insane to varying degrees, and the Black Tower is the worst of the worst! The Central Tower of the Federation never assigns Guides there—because no Guide is willing to live among madmen and end up as nothing more than a pile of bones!
As a pure human—now extinct in this world—Su Qiqian is lucky that none of the other Guides here have spirit animals, allowing her to keep up her disguise. As the first high-ranking Guide ever exiled to the Black Tower, the moment the mad dogs caught wind of her arrival, they went wild behind the scenes, lusting after that pure, untouchable goddess on a pedestal…
—
Su Qiqian turned on the bedroom light—and her pupils trembled. What the h**l is this?!!
The sentinels, who had been carefully pretending to be normal during the day, were now kneeling beside her bed with bulging muscles and over-the-top outfits. Their outrageously handsome faces looked pitiful as they pleaded:
“Miss Guide, please… we’re begging you…”
associated_names: 纯人类流放黑塔被疯批哨兵强制爱

116782.synopsis:
He was the knight serving the Crown Prince.
She was the assassin sent by the Second Prince.
Trained from a young age, she never disobeyed the organization’s orders. Even if it meant being transformed into a woman to seduce the captain of the knights, she accepted it without complaint.
Disguised as a young maid, she infiltrated the home of that seemingly carefree knight.
“He must never find out who I really am,” she said.
“Better not alert her just yet, I’ll play along for now,” he said.
“To stabilize the situation, I should first gain his/her favor.” —They said in unison.
associated_names: 刺杀，从成为女仆获取好感开始

117806.synopsis:
The Huaxia Meteorological Bureau recently detected over a hundred types of abnormal weather phenomena. Based on classical texts and records from various experts, the entire planet may undergo unexpected changes within the next ten days.
“‘Spirits’ are coming. The end is near.” Xu Ye said firmly.
Just moments ago, a mysterious system suddenly appeared.
【Apocalypse Comeback System Activated】
【Earth is contaminated by an unknown force. Order has collapsed. An unprecedented apocalyptic age of chaos has arrived—man-eating monsters, nightmare spirits, authoritarian enforcers of order… And you must survive. Fortunately, you’ve awakened a D-Class ability: Regeneration. With this ability, you’ve been barely hanging on…】
【Now marks the tenth year since the apocalypse began】
【It’s time for your comeback, Host.】
【Use every means at your disposal to eliminate the S-Class dark phenomenon: Withered Time Blackwater. Completing this mission will earn you an S-Class ability—Master of Time.】
Following the precise coordinates given by the system, Xu Ye nervously located the site of the S-Class dark phenomenon “Withered Time Blackwater.”
Staring at a puddle of industrial wastewater, he froze in place.
“This thing is an S-Class disaster?”
【The system arrived ten years early! You call this an S-Class disaster?】
【The apocalypse hasn’t even started yet, and I’m already invincible!】
【I am the Supreme God of Huaxia!】
associated_names: 还没末日，你把S级灾难清完了？

118574.synopsis:
“Judging by your response, Logan Ferrell. You are a human female.”
In a society suffering from extreme food shortages due to a population explosion, humanity ventures into unexplored regions of space in search of habitable star systems.
During one such mission, soldier Logan and his team crash-land on an uncharted planet after a spacecraft malfunction. Separated from his unit, Logan encounters an unknown being who calls itself Skyryl.
Skyryl claims that Logan’s body is the vessel that will resurrect its dying species and begins to conduct experiments on him.
Can Logan escape from Skyryl’s grasp… or will he become the progenitor of a new human species?

119598.synopsis:
[Space + Stockpiling + Modern-to-Ancient Time Travel + Natural Disasters + Famine Escape] 
Qian Chunhua, who had been single all her life, suddenly time-traveled—bringing along a space full of supplies.
..
She gained something she had dreamed of before time-traveling: children.
..
To her shock, she discovered that one of the children had been switched at birth.
..
After setting things right,
she led the three children through natural disasters and wartime chaos…
..
In the end, she successfully raised all three children into adulthood.
..
This story contains no romantic pairing (No CP).

130862.synopsis:
When Bai Xuechao was about to die from illness, he bound with a system claiming to come from a “Higher-Dimensional Comic Website.”
He learned that the world he lived in was actually a comic, and that the main villain had accidentally died half an hour ago. After analysis, he was deemed the most suitable candidate to take over the villain’s role.
As long as he could complete the villain’s tasks, the system would arrange a fake death for him and grant him a healthy body.
In order to survive, Bai Xuechao agreed.
Night fell, and the city lights glittered brilliantly.
A frail boy sat at the edge of the hospital rooftop, his snow-white hair fluttering in the wind. A smile surfaced in his ruby-like red eyes.
“This boring world… is finally starting to get interesting.”
* * *
《Superpower × Food Chain》 is currently the hottest urban superpower action comic.
After the introduction of the new character Bai Xuechao, its popularity soared.
From his very first appearance, his image as a frail, beautiful boy with white hair and red eyes made his popularity skyrocket. Later, his chaotic and playful personality, combined with his extremely high intelligence, as if he were holding the script himself, pushed him straight into the top ten of the popularity rankings.
However, no one knew that his true identity was actually one of the four executives of a dark organization. He had fabricated his backstory and infiltrated the protagonist’s group with ulterior motives.
The unaware readers: [My charming wife! prprpr~] 
* * * 
System Xiao 6 thought it had just bound to an ordinary host, but unexpectedly, it turned out to be a living god.
First, the host stole 20% of the male lead’s personality within the story, becoming the first character ever to make the author publicly call him out and beg for mercy online.
Later, he even struck a deal with the author to turn the comic into a massive hit, all while securing bonus rewards for it.
Xiao 6: “What living god? He’s not just my host—he’s my real dad!”
associated_names: 扮演反派后我在漫画人气登顶

134190.synopsis:
I was cursed for the sin of coveting a sacred relic—
a curse that doomed me to die and return, over and over again.
To break this cycle, I must save my sworn enemy, Leandros.
But persuading a man who despises me is no simple task.
So I decided to speak honestly.
“Your Highness, I am caught in a cycle of regression. Whenever I turn twenty, I die suddenly—no matter the cause. Then I return to the day of my eighteenth birthday.”
“Is that so. Regrettably, I cannot be of help, so let us pretend I never heard it.”
“Yet every time you die, I also die—and the regression begins anew.”
“Your jest is rather cruel.”
Naturally, he did not believe me.
So I resolved to prove it.
“Would you like to confirm it for yourself?”
I lifted his wine glass, clinked it against the empty air, and said:
“Cheers.”
The moment I drank, searing pain struck me.
I coughed up not wine but a flood of red liquid.
Through my dimming vision, I caught sight of his shocked expression—
and I smiled.
The way to move an upright man is guilt.
But… perhaps it worked too well?
“My lady may be mischievous and teasing at times, but that is only outwardly. In truth, you are a good-hearted person.”
“I would like us to be more than acquaintances. Let us be special friends—only then can we truly act for one another.”
“I once heard that children can see a person’s true heart. Perhaps it is true.”
The way he looked at me… it was utterly different now.
Did this man not hate me…?

136494.synopsis:
Zhao An, born in an era of spiritual energy revival, transmigrates into a dated, angsty romance novel titled Tears of a City-Toppling Beauty. He becomes the female lead’s younger brother—a cannon fodder character used by the tyrant to threaten the female lead, who is fated to perish during the torturous romance between the emperor and his consort. The kind that starves to death.
Fortunately, Zhao An still retains a bit of his wood-elemental ability, allowing him to forage for wild vegetables in the mountains. He finds strawberries to earn money and secure his basic needs, then discovers rare medicinal herbs and makes a small fortune. Finally, he finds a drunk man.
Hu Sheng opens his gray-blue eyes. “I am the chief of Daqing Stronghold. If you don’t leave now, I’m going to take you up the mountain to be my wife.”
Looking at the chief’s handsome, mixed-race features, Zhao An thinks that being the chief’s wife sounds great. The whole point of his transmigration must have been to find a partner. He helps the chief up and, with great difficulty, finds Daqing Stronghold. Upon seeing that the stronghold is filled with the old, weak, sick, and disabled, Zhao An heaves a deep sigh. From that day forward, he embarks on the grand enterprise of farming—improving grain seeds, creating fertilizer, and modifying farm tools, so busy that he loses all track of time.
In the blink of an eye, three years have passed since the original novel’s ending. The male and female leads, who loved to court disaster, have indeed managed to get themselves killed, plunging the nation into chaos and division in the process. Fortunately, Zhao An has both grain and guns in hand and is confident he can defeat the various ambitious warlord factions.
In the end, Hu Sheng, the former mountain chieftain who is now hailed as the God of War, points to the throne in the golden hall and asks, “Do you want to be the emperor?”
Zhao An is tempted, but the memory of his original fate—being starved to death simply because the emperor wanted to teach his consort a lesson—makes him shake his head resolutely. “We both come from humble beginnings,” Zhao An says. “Let’s establish a republic instead.”

152878.synopsis:
After transmigrating to a cultivation world, Lin Yuan could only become a menial disciple in the sect due to his poor aptitude. Unexpectedly, he awakened a God-level Side Effect Transfer System. From that moment on, he could assign others to bear all the negative side effects of consuming pills or practicing techniques.
Bloodburn Pill—gains strength by burning one’s lifespan, so dangerous that no one dares to take it unless absolutely desperate? Take it, of course! Take it like it’s candy!
A newly promoted sect elder suddenly turns white-haired overnight and dies from the Five Decays of Heaven and Man.
Golden Body Tempering Technique—eat metal to strengthen the body, but it could tear your insides apart and cause a gruesome death? Great! Let’s start with 100 kilograms of gold bars to see how it tastes.
A demonic cultivator refining a magic treasure suddenly coughs up blood, ruining decades of scheming and effort.
He wants everything that comes with side effects—Heavenly Demon Disintegration, Blood Escape Technique, Nine Deaths Evil Technique… Lin Yuan wants it all.
Decades later, when Lin Yuan summoned the heavenly tribulation and was about to ascend, all major powers gathered to stop him.
But in the very next moment, every single lightning strike from the tribulation landed on them instead, and countless experts perished.
What?! You’re the one undergoing tribulation, why are we the ones being struck by lightning?!
associated_names: 修仙：挂我开，副作用你扛

191790.synopsis:
Everyone says that Wei Xiaomiao possesses a heart of exquisite wit and unparalleled cleverness.
Yet, this supposedly brilliant mind is merely a colourless crystal bead—unable to act on its own volition, reflecting the treacherous nature of the imperial court with constant trepidation.
Plagued by self-loathing and a sense of inherent inferiority rooted in his lowly birth and eunuch status, he tries his utmost to ignore the fierce, burning affection the Seventh Prince harbours for him.
Faced with the Seventh Prince’s painstaking, unyielding pursuit, Xiaomiao chooses to flee with cautious deliberation. Beneath his flawlessly respectful exterior lies a heart utterly adrift, harboring an unspoken yearning that has been carved deep into his very bones.
Wei Xiaomiao says, “Your Highness, there is no need for you to trouble yourself so greatly for my sake.”
The Seventh Prince replies, “It is my absolute pleasure to trouble myself for your sake.”
A turbulent struggle born of conflicting emotions, interwoven with the tender intimacy of a stirring passion. Wei Xiaomiao merely seeks to capture a fleeting moment of stolen bliss, a memory to sustain him for a lifetime. Yet, what the Seventh Prince demands is eternity—an obsession that will endure until death takes them both.
After countless twists, turns, and emotional tribulations, when his drifting heart finally finds its solid ground, he only wishes to whisper to the Seventh Prince once more:
“May I win the heart of my only love, and may we never part, even when our hair turns as white as snow.”
